note: Month-end closes since 2019, for drawing a multi-year shape. Monthly bars hide daily noise - use the daily series or the live candles for short-term moves.

cautions.monthly: One point per month. A crash that recovered inside a month is invisible here.
cautions.adjusted: Split and bonus adjusted, so a 1:10 split does not read as a 90% fall.
cautions.survivorship: Only stocks listed today are included.
